title: calculate_qc_metrics

input.description: Input data. Can be encoded in H5 or Zarr (v3) format.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

layer.description: Layer from modality to use as input data. If not provided the .X attribute is used.

log1p_transform.description:
Compute log1p-transformed versions of the metrics added to `.var` and `.obs`.
For each emitted metric column `<col>`, an additional column `log1p_<col>` is added
containing `log1p(<col>)`. Mirrors scanpy's `log1p` flag.

var_qc_metrics.description:
Keys to select a boolean (containing only True or False) column from .var.
For each cell, calculate the proportion of total values for genes which are labeled 'True', 
compared to the total sum of the values for all genes.

var_qc_metrics_fill_na_value.description:
Fill any 'NA' values found in the columns specified with --var_qc_metrics to 'True' or 'False'.
as False.

top_n_vars.description:
Number of top vars to be used to calculate cumulative proportions.
If not specified, proportions are not calculated. `--top_n_vars 20;50` finds
cumulative proportion to the 20th and 50th most expressed vars.

output_obs_top_n_vars.description:
Format string for the names of the .obs columns that contain the cumulative
proportion of counts in the top N vars (one column per value in `--top_n_vars`).
Use `{n}` as a placeholder for the top-N value provided in `--top_n_vars`.

output_obs_num_nonzero_vars.description:
Name of column in .obs describing, for each observation, the number of stored values
(including explicit zeroes). In other words, the name of the column that counts
for each row the number of columns that contain data.

output_obs_total_counts_vars.description:
Name of the column for .obs describing, for each observation (row),
the sum of the stored values in the columns.

output_var_num_nonzero_obs.description:
Name of column describing, for each feature, the number of stored values
(including explicit zeroes). In other words, the name of the column that counts
for each column the number of rows that contain data.

output_var_total_counts_obs.description:
Name of the column in .var describing, for each feature (column),
the sum of the stored values in the rows.

output_var_obs_mean.description: Name of the column in .obs providing the mean of the values in each row.

output_var_pct_dropout.description:
Name of the column in .obs providing for each feature the percentage of
observations the feature does not appear on (i.e. is missing). Same as `--num_nonzero_obs`
but percentage based.

output.description: Output data. Can be encoded using H5 or Zarr v3, matching the format of the input data.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
